description: This Java source file defines the EntryListFragment class, which is a ListFragment displaying a list of Atom feed entries stored in a local database. It manages data loading via Loaders, handles user interaction such as refresh actions, and opens article URLs in a browser. It also observes sync status to update UI elements accordingly.

classes.name: EntryListFragment
classes.description: A Fragment subclass that displays a list of feed entries and manages synchronization and UI updates related to sync status and data display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initial setup of the fragment, enabling options menu.

methods.name: onAttach
methods.description: Creates a sync account if needed when fragment attaches.

methods.name: onViewCreated
methods.description: Initializes the list adapter, sets view binder, and initiates loader.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Sets up sync status observer listener.

methods.name: onCreateLoader
methods.description: Creates a CursorLoader to query the feed entries.

methods.name: onLoadFinished
methods.description: Updates the adapter with new data when load completes.

methods.name: onLoaderReset
methods.description: Clears adapter data when loader is reset.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the menu for refresh action.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles refresh menu action to trigger data sync.

methods.name: onListItemClick
methods.description: Opens the selected feed entry URL in a browser.

methods.name: setRefreshActionButtonState
methods.description: Updates the refresh button to show indeterminate progress or normal state.

methods.name: mSyncStatusObserver
methods.description: Internal observer for sync status changes to update UI.
